title: Skylume ☆ Hypixel Skyblock
description: Hypixel SkyBlock QoL with Storage, Item Guard, dungeon guides and routes, terminal practice, run/loot analysis, Kuudra/Slayer helpers, Bazaar orders, item prices, chat and customizable HUDs.
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60757aaf4905b2a0e78b350ccf56bf9632f7147a.png) # ✦ SkyLume ✦ *A modern quality-of-life mod for Hypixel SkyBlock.* SkyLume is a client-side Fabric mod focused on useful SkyBlock tools, responsive interfaces and extensive customization. Find stored items, protect your equipment, follow routes and keep the information you need within reach. **Minecraft 26.2 release — SkyLume 2.6.0:** Dungeon puzzles and boss guides, a custom route workshop with 138 local room layouts, terminal training, Spirit Leap cards, run and loot history, Bazaar order observations, Kuudra and own-boss Slayer assistance, slot bindings, Fishing and Sweep, zoom and visual scaling are now included alongside Storage, Item Guard, chat and HUD tools. Open **`/sl`** or **`/skylume`** to get started. Gameplay movement and combat remain manual. ## 📖 Features
🎣 Fishing and Sweep * Observe supported catches, sea creatures and trophy fish from client-visible game messages * Browse locally saved fishing sessions and catch history with `/sl fishing` * Optional fishing timers and relevant alerts for supported buffs and events * Open `/sl sweep` for a live activity overview and configurable overlays * Configure world markers, tracking and optional HUD visibility separately History and timers depend on messages and entities your client receives. Counts are observations, not an authenticated full account history. Open main settings from each workspace to configure its options.
🧩 Dungeon Puzzles, Devices and Boss Guides * Higher/Lower Blaze: green current target, white next target and a connecting line * Three Weirdos reward chest, Quiz answer buttons and Tic Tac Toe move guidance * Ice Fill and Silverfish/Ice Path lines visible through translucent ice * Boulder next-button highlight and an obstacle-aware walking approach * Coloured Creeper Beam pairs, with completed pairs shown separately * Water Board one-flow lever sequences, timing rows, next-lever tracer and recovery when joining mid-board * Teleport Maze visited pads and direction-based exit candidates * F7/M7 Simon Says memory, Arrow Align click counts and Sharp Shooter targets * Starred mobs, minibosses, keys, local secret markers and Wither/Blood doors from server map data * Guardian health, Livid selection, Thorn arena guidance, terracotta estimates, Gyro aim/cooldown and Goldor task guidance * Blood Camp spawn predictions; M7 dragon countdowns, priority groups and relic altar guidance * Saved per-floor role assignments for stun, bow, Gyro, crystals, pads and terminals Open `/sl dungeons guides` for live management and `/sl dungeons roles` for role plans. Ordinary controls and appearance options stay under **Dungeons** in the main settings. Boss and assistant HUDs are optional and start off. Solvers require recognized rooms, rotations, boards and loaded puzzle chunks. Door guides require a calibrated map supplied by the server. Unknown data is not filled in with guesses. Boulder guidance follows the included push sequences; it is not a full dynamic push solver. Water, spawn and cooldown timings are estimates. Movement, combat and every puzzle click remain manual.
🛠️ Custom Dungeon Route Workshop * Create named route sets, copy existing routes and edit points, actions and steps with Undo * Use 138 included room layouts with locally bundled secret data * Record a walking path and choose a custom route for a room * Review room geometry and routes in a separate creative practice world * Keep creator, source and license information for included route and room data Open `/sl dungeons editor`. The practice world demonstrates room geometry and routes; it does not simulate Hypixel combat or secret rewards. No Skyblocker installation or runtime room download is needed. Imported routes remain editable and gameplay actions remain manual.
🎯 Terminal Training and Spirit Leap * `/sl training` offers six local terminal simulations: panes, numbers, same colour, starts-with, select-colour and Melody * Choose a terminal type or Random, simulated round-trip delay from 0–500 ms and optional hints * Save the last 500 completed attempts with time, mistakes and clicks; clean records are separated by terminal type, delay and hints * Spirit Leap and Teleport to Player use four stable player cards with saved favourites * Choose a card with 1–4, a click, or an optional keyboard/mouse class binding * View observed teammate room positions when the compact map has enough space * Duplicate classes require an unambiguous favourite or explicit player choice Training runs entirely locally. Spirit Leap performs one vanilla click after your explicit input and rechecks the live menu, player head, availability and empty cursor. Small windows retain the original server menu. Overlapping Odin/Skyblocker helpers take priority with the existing compatibility option enabled.
📈 Dungeon Run Analysis and Loot History * `/sl analysis` compares locally recorded runs by floor, room and recorded route version * Best, median and average room observations; sample counts, scores, deaths and observed splits * Compare the latest ten runs against the previous ten when a floor has at least twenty records * Separate edited route versions; mixed or unknown routes are excluded from route comparisons * Record supported manually purchased dungeon chests after matching server confirmation * Freeze observed reward estimates, chest/key/Kismet costs and configured selling-fee estimates at purchase time * Browse profile-scoped loot history, filter by floor and export CSV * Show Croesus/Vesuvius opened or exhausted states and optional read-only junk outlines Opening a chest does not record a purchase. Run tracking must be enabled for new analysis data; opening analysis does not enable a HUD or tracking. Unknown or stale prices remain visibly incomplete. Estimated reward value is not realized sale profit, and room times include fighting and revisits.
🌋 Kuudra and Own-boss Slayer Assistance * Observe Kuudra phases, supply recovery/delivery, construction progress, builders and Fresh Tools * Supply pickup/delivery and construction markers, plus a configurable local T3–T5 stun reminder * Optional Kuudra HUD, off by default and movable through the standard HUD editor * Own Voidgloom Yang Glyph cues and an approximate laser timer * Own Inferno attunement colours and observed Fire Pillar countdowns * Riftstalker Twinclaws/Holy Ice and Steak Stake reminders Controls live under **Training, combat & trading**. Boss ownership and mechanic association use visible entities and proximity; ambiguous nearby bosses suppress cues. These are local reminders and estimates. No automatic attacks, abilities, movement or party messages are sent by these assistants. Installed overlapping helpers take priority when compatibility is enabled.
📋 Bazaar Order Overview * `/sl orders` browses Your/Co-op Bazaar Orders pages you have visited * Filter own/co-op, buy/sell and item name; sort by observed value or status * Show fills, remaining value before tax, owner and claimable item counts * Compare with the best buy-order/sell-offer levels, separately from weighted quick-status estimates * Keep partial page observations and store history per confirmed SkyBlock profile * Copy an exact remaining quantity or unit price for manual use * Optional outbid notices start disabled and require a recent observed status transition Open the real orders inventory to capture or refresh data. Observations older than two minutes are marked old. Rounded fills are marked approximate and cannot be copied as exact quantities. Unavailable, malformed or stale price data stays unknown. SkyLume does not create, cancel or claim an order for you.
🔗 Slot Bindings and Inventory Navigation * Save named one-to-one bindings between hotbar and inventory/armour slots * Hover a slot and use the rebindable binding key (L by default), then choose its partner * Shift-click a bound slot for one explicit vanilla inventory swap * Optional thin binding lines and outlines, with Escape to cancel an unfinished binding * Preserve Item Guard protection and refuse items that cannot enter the target slot * Configurable Quicknav tabs and keyboard selection in supported Loadouts, Armour Sets, Equipment Sets and Wardrobe menus * Optional container-value button with a scrollable, partial-data-aware price breakdown Slot bindings are opt-in. Active Odin or NoFrills slot binding retains control with compatibility enabled. Named collections use dedicated editors; ordinary controls stay in main settings.
📏 Visual Scaling, Held Items and Camera * Scale yourself, other players, SkyBlock NPCs, villagers and dropped items from 0.1×–4× * Independent on/off switches retain saved sizes and a third-person preview restores your previous camera * Per-player rules, Keep visible exceptions and reviewed preset import/export * Held-item scale, XYZ position/rotation, independent off-hand values and custom swing appearance * Own server-formatted name/rank in third person, adjustable name-tag height and optional camera/crosshair controls * Optional nearby-player and fire-overlay hiding Open `/sl scale`, `/sl scale players` or the advanced visual editor from main settings. Scaling changes rendering and local animation; camera height, hitboxes, reach and attack packets are unchanged. Active Scale Me transforms take precedence; Aaron's Mod retains name-tag appearance when installed.
🔭 Zoom and SkyBlock helpers * Hold C for smooth zoom; scroll to adjust. Configure hold/toggle, easing, sensitivity, hand FOV, spyglass and cinematic zoom with `/sl zoom`. * Remember Chronomatron, Ultrasequencer and revealed Superpairs cards. * Guides for Blaze, Three Weirdos, Trivia, Boulder, Ice Fill, Creeper Beams, Tic Tac Toe and Ice Path. Water Board offers one-flow lever sequences with server-confirmed progress; Teleport Maze narrows exit candidates after teleports. * F7/M7 Simon Says memory, Arrow Align remaining clicks and Sharp Shooter targets. * M7 dragon countdowns, selectable priority groups and relic altar guidance. * Etherwarp landing estimates and optional movement-key closing of secret chests. * `/sl progress` tracks observed numeric skill XP, active rate and idle pause. * Ctrl+F searches item names and lore, including enchantment menus. Optional rarity outlines. * Observed item/pet counters, Puzzler target, Golden Fish timer, mining/Slayer notices and an optional pet/Forge/Commission/Soulflow status HUD. Open `/sl extras` to configure helpers. All movement, shots and clicks stay manual. Unknown boards remain unknown. Installed Zoomify takes priority for zoom; Skyblocker/Odin take priority for overlapping helpers by default. This is not full SBE feature parity.
⚔️ Combat and everyday QoL * Observed ability cooldowns and Wither Shield duration; supported Mage reductions. * Held-drill fuel display and configurable low-fuel alerts. * `/sl slayers` shows local boss/tier kills, failures, best and average times. * Keyboard selection in Loadouts, Armor Sets, Equipment Sets and legacy Wardrobe. * Hover a pet and press F to save a favorite star; active pets get a checkmark. * Checkmarks for completed Commission books. * Optional duplicate-item-type badges and hotbar rarity outlines. Open `/sl qol`. Item timers, Slayer and skill/status displays have separate HUD editor groups. Compatibility settings give installed helpers priority where they overlap. Cooldowns and landing previews use observed information and remain estimates.
📦 Storage Search and Overview A fast and interactive interface for browsing your SkyBlock Storage. * View saved Ender Chest and Backpack pages in one interface * Search indexed items by name or SkyBlock item ID * Open a matching Storage page directly from the overlay * Interact with items through the real server-side Storage container * Refresh changed items and reuse cached search results * Preserve search state, scroll position and selected pages * Dim non-matching items with a configurable highlight colour * Preview saved pages with full item lore and compatible price additions * Use Edit Pages, the Farming Toolkit or the Hunting Toolkit with a return-to-Storage button * Adapt the overview to the available screen width * Support compatible inventory shortcuts and exclusion zones Cached previews and background saving keep browsing and searching responsive. **Only pages opened by the player are indexed.** Saved previews show previously observed contents; open a page again to update it. SkyLume does not access unloaded Storage data. Open `/sl storage`.
✦ Item Guard Protect equipment from accidental loss without locking it to an inventory slot. * Hover an item and press **U** to lock or unlock it * Use the same key while holding an item outside menus * Rebind the key in Minecraft Controls * Follow the item's UUID through inventory, hotbar and Storage moves * Keep the lock through renames and upgrades that retain that UUID * Block dropping, NPC selling, bulk inventory sales, trade offers, Auction House listing and salvage in supported screens * Block confirmation of already staged locked items while still allowing you to take them back * Show a small gold star in the slot and **✦ Locked** beneath the tooltip name * Save locks locally for your Minecraft account * Keep blocked actions silent by default, with optional short feedback outside chat Normal inventory movement still works. Closing the inventory while holding a locked item lets Minecraft return it to inventory. If there is no room, Item Guard prevents the overflow drop. Turning Item Guard off keeps your saved locks. Lock/unlock confirmations use SkyLume’s local feedback display. Optional **Blocked-action feedback** has a cooldown and respects the global **Local feedback** setting. **Items without a stable UUID use item-type protection:** all copies of that type are protected, as explained in the lock message. Item Guard handles supported client actions; it cannot prevent server-forced item changes. Settings: **Inventory → Item Guard**.
📍 Waypoints and Routes Create, organize and follow local SkyBlock waypoints in Waypoint Studio. * Create points from your position, crosshair or explicitly formatted chat coordinates * Use `/sl w here [name]` or `/sl w [name] [perm]` * Accept supported comma-separated coordinates * Configure names, distance labels, colours, marker styles, beams, tracers and through-wall rendering * Organize points into expandable groups with island and zone filters * Build ordered routes with connected lines, looping and nearest-start selection * Use intermediate Path points to shape lines without treating every point as a stop * Follow fast running and short teleports without waiting on crossed path points * Advance through turns in order, use the configured arrival radius and skip disabled points * Follow a guide to the start, pause, resume, restart, go back or select another point * Use Follow, Overview and Setup views, an interactive route map and upcoming-point previews * Record a route passively, review it and save when ready * Search, edit, duplicate, multi-select, hide, restore and delete points * Use draft editing and 40-step undo/redo * Store up to 4,096 points across 64 groups Global routes remain accessible under island filters. **Clear filters** returns to all saved groups, including older routes that previously appeared only in the world. Import/export supports SkyLume and selected external waypoint formats. Intermediate coordinates stay editable through **Tools → Show path nodes for editing**. Supported formats differ by import/export direction. Creator credits are retained in SkyLume V2 exports. Waypoint sharing requires an explicit player action. Route movement remains manual. Labels show distance without an arrival ETA. Open `/sl w`; start recording with `/sl w record`.
🗺️ Community Routes — Galatea, Torrhus and Crystal Hollows Browse ten included, credited routes without downloading a separate pack. * **Torrhus:** Honeyhives, Hideonsun and Fairy Soul navigation tours * **Galatea:** Hideonleaf and Fairy Soul navigation tours * **Crystal Hollows:** five legacy mining-route collections credited to FireAndIce, Snow, DKMCC, Dragoonmaster4 and Tuhp * Search by route, island or creator * Preview coordinates on the route map before adding anything * Add an editable copy, retaining creator, source and license information * Keep numbered mining stops separate from optional preparation/alternative markers Open **`/sl w` → Community routes**. Added copies start **disabled**. Enable the copy and press **Save** in the manager when ready. Existing edited copies are preserved. The Galatea/Torrhus entries are navigation and collection tours based on published route data. The mining entries are legacy coordinate collections, not a current efficiency ranking. Movement, mining and collection remain manual. Dungeon secret routes use the automatic room-based system below.
⚔️ Dungeons — Map, Secrets and Score A shared dungeon system for solo and party runs. * Display Hypixel’s original dungeon map automatically in solo and party runs * Preserve the black background, unexplored rooms, question marks, doors and completion marks * Show the map as soon as server map data arrives, without waiting for room recognition * Display rotating player heads, class colours and a clear direction marker * Enable an optional thin outline, small room names or secret-count labels * Track floor, room, classes, deaths, secrets, puzzle state and boss/run phases * Calculate projected score using floor requirements, penalties and bonuses * Support Entrance, F1–F7 and M1–M7 score rules * Account for blood/boss projection, crypts and supported Spirit, Paul, Mimic, Prince and Bat bonuses * Track 270/300 thresholds, run timers and splits * Distinguish projected score from the final server result * Show time penalties and the countdown to the next time-point loss * Show unknown values as unknown and estimates with missing inputs as **~** * Enable large S/S+ score popups with an optional pling * Move and scale the map, score HUD and optional Dungeon details list independently The map is a clean square without a text footer. Enable **Dungeon details HUD** for a separate list of room, projected score, time and route instructions. Place it beside the map or anywhere else with `/sl gui`. **270/300 sharing is optional.** Customize separate messages using `{score}`, `{threshold}`, `{floor}`, `{secrets}`, `{deaths}` and `{time}`. Messages go to party chat with teammates, or dungeon all-chat when solo. Each threshold is announced once per run; an empty message disables that announcement. A projected score can decrease with time or deaths; the server determines the final rank. Map, score, party information and secret routes share the same run data. Open `/sl dungeons`. Configure displays, score messages and score popups under **Dungeons → Map and score**. Room identification and bonus information use data visible to the client or supported optional providers.
🧭 Automatic Dungeon Secret Routes **210 included routes/variants for 109 room identities**, credited to **FlameOfWar** and **3ppopka**. * Use the included packs without manual importing or selecting every room * Match routes to the same room detection and rotation used by the dungeon map * Follow thin connected lines, small direction arrows and a gold guide to the route start * See upcoming Stonk/Dungeonbreaker, Superboom, Etherwarp, Ender Pearl and interaction instructions before arrival * Read named start/action markers through walls with adjustable label size * Keep the start visible until collection, even after passing it while clearing * Advance from supported chest, essence, pickup, bat and interaction observations * Continue past locked chests, then return to uncollected secrets before the exit * Use Skip step, Previous or Retry skipped when needed * Search rooms and creators in a dedicated browser * Pause a room, navigate steps or choose an optional alternative * Import supported custom JSON routes while retaining creator/source credits * Preserve progress when revisiting a room and guide back to a missed start * Reset route state between runs and hide secret routes during boss phases Open `/sl dungeons routes`. Routes appear after the room and its rotation are identified. New or unrecognized rooms wait for identification. Some routes assume particular movement items or techniques; SkyLume does not perform those actions for you. The two included packs retain their original GPL-3.0 license, editable data and source information inside the JAR.
💰 Market Prices and Estimated Item Value Read compact, aligned prices inside item tooltips. * NPC sell price * Bazaar buy/sell estimates, with stack totals and per-item references * Lowest BIN price * One-day or three-day average BIN price * Crafting Price from supported crafting and forge recipes * Estimated Item Value, including supported upgrades * George sell prices for supported pets * Rift Motes values with configurable McGrubber stacks Gold/yellow labels and teal values sit directly after ordinary item lore, before date/museum information. Rows stay compact while Shift is held. Optional duplicate suppression avoids repeating matching fields from other tooltip sources. Prices work **without a player API key**. Requests and valuation run in the background and share cached data with SkyLume's command helpers. Supported item variants use their corresponding quote IDs; missing quotes are not replaced with misleading generic prices. Prices are references and estimates, including for soulbound items. BIN/averages are base-item references; Bazaar estimates exclude fees/slippage and forge prices exclude waiting time. Stale or partial results are marked. An unavailable source may leave a field unavailable. Settings: **Tooltips → Market prices**.
⚡ Inventory Buttons Create programmable buttons around supported inventory screens. * Choose a button name, item icon, tooltip and command * Select icons through a searchable Minecraft item picker * Drag buttons around the inventory * Resize buttons with the mouse wheel in placement mode * Organize and toggle buttons in the dedicated Quick Access editor * Execute a command when you explicitly click its button Open `/sl quick-access` or use SkyLume settings.
💬 Chat Quality of Life Client-side tools for reading and organizing chat. * Copy the message under the cursor with a configurable mouse button * Preserve readable characters, formatting and original click/hover events where possible * Search with case-sensitive and regular-expression options * Choose reset-on-close or remembered search drafts * Switch between All, Party, Guild and Private views with optional unread indicators * Select All, Party or Guild to filter received messages and switch the Hypixel sending channel * See the confirmed sending channel and keep your draft while a switch is pending * Compact repeated messages with configurable matching, counters, prefix, suffix and colours * Keep an extended, configurable message history for the current session * Highlight player names and custom phrases using editable text/regex rules * Filter matching messages through local rules * Show optional toasts, movable message popups and local action feedback * Configure notification rules, colours, duration and sounds * Use optional party-chat formatting and contextual carry actions Tabs and their filters appear only in **Hypixel SkyBlock** by default. Enable **Show outside SkyBlock** to keep local tabs elsewhere; other servers never receive Hypixel channel commands. Hiding the tabs also suspends their filter. The Private view filters direct messages; use `/msg ` or `/r` to reply. One-off `/pc`, `/gc`, `/msg` and `/r` messages do not change the selected channel. Party Commands and dungeon score sharing have their own settings. Open chat and use its controls, or open `/sl chat-search` and activate the search control.
☺ Clickable Chat Symbols The **☺ button in chat** opens 32 searchable symbols and emotes. * See the actual symbol beside its name * Search by name or supported shortcut * Click to insert at the caret or replace selected text * Press Enter to choose a search result * Scroll for more symbols and press Escape to close the picker * Keep your chat draft while browsing Examples include **❤**, **✮**, **✔**, **✖**, **➜** and `¯\_(ツ)_/¯`. Inserting a symbol does not send your message. These are plain Unicode characters; premium rank colours are not added. Settings: **Chat → Chat symbols**.
🖱️ Movable Tooltips Make long SkyBlock item descriptions easier to read. * Scroll long item tooltips with the mouse wheel; use Shift + wheel for horizontal movement when enabled * Configure movement speed and optional movement/reset keys in Minecraft Controls * Use smooth interpolated movement * Keep the scroll position when prices or other live lore update; start at the top for a different item * Move clipped tooltips beyond the screen boundary when enabled * Avoid supported screens where tooltip movement would interfere with normal scrolling This feature moves the tooltip without truncating its contents.
🎛️ HUD and Interface Editor Arrange SkyLume displays on a transparent canvas with a clear view of the world. * Drag each element independently and scroll to resize * Right-click an element for its options * Move with arrow keys: one pixel normally, ten while holding Shift * Resize with +/- and reset the selected element with middle-click * Snap to a grid, screen edges or other SkyLume elements * Use alignment guides, optional icons and 0–100% panel opacity * Keep positions when a widget is disabled * Preview supported widgets while editing * Preview, apply, undo, import and export HUD presets Available displays include Booster Cookie time, Pest Repellent, sprint status, coordinates, ping, estimated TPS, a local clock, route progress, dungeon map, dungeon score, Dungeon details, Party HUD, Carry HUD and local feedback/popups. **First-time installs keep the established starter UI/HUD placements and preferences. New optional HUD panels, including dungeon assistant, boss, details and Kuudra panels, start disabled. Existing users keep their own saved settings and layouts. Tracking and world assistance have separate controls from HUD visibility.** Personal commands, messages and gameplay history are not included in the starter preferences. Open `/sl gui`. Preview values in the editor are examples.
📊 Ping, TPS and Status Displays Compact status information with configurable appearance. * Smoothed ping and TPS estimation * Configurable good, medium and poor status colours * Stable, whole-number TPS display * Cached Booster Cookie duration between sessions * Regular/MAX Pest Repellent timing from observed activation information * Passive sprint-status display * Local clock with seconds and 12/24-hour formats TPS is an estimate. Cookie/repellent timers depend on observed information. SkyLume's sprint toggle is singleplayer-only; the passive sprint display also works on servers.
⌨️ Command Keys and Aliases Create shortcuts for frequently used commands. * Bind commands to Minecraft keybinds with conflict information * Create aliases such as `/dh` → `/warp dungeon_hub` * Show aliases as chat command suggestions * Organize entries into expandable nested groups * Keep keys and aliases in separate editors * Use included SkyBlock destination and Dungeon presets * Toggle, edit or remove individual entries and complete groups * Restore the default presets when needed Open `/sl commands` or `/sl aliases`. A button, key or alias runs when you explicitly use it.
🔍 SkyBlock Command Helpers Open **`/sl sb`** to browse local lookups. Selecting a command opens an editable chat draft. * `/sl sb lbin ` — lowest BIN and a configurable 1-, 3- or 7-day average * `/sl sb bzprice ` — Bazaar quotes, order counts, volume and weekly activity * `/sl sb profile [player]` — profile summary * `/sl sb cata [player]` — Catacombs, classes and completions * `/sl sb mp [player]` — recorded magical power, power and tuning * `/sl sb essence [player]` — essence balances * `/sl sb crimson [player]` — supported Crimson Isle statistics * `/sl sb croesus [player]` — unclaimed dungeon chests Omit the player to look up yourself. Item/player suggestions help complete commands. Prices reuse the same cache as tooltips and remain available when price tooltips are disabled. Hover a result for its source and age. Fresh profile lookups require a compatible optional profile provider; existing local profile caches may remain available without it. Recorded MP is not a guarantee of the currently equipped value. Price lookups work independently. Unavailable average feeds leave the available BIN result visible. Other command roots remain unaffected; `/sl sb` remains available alongside them.
👥 Party Tools A compact Party Manager backed by shared membership, presence and class information. * Track observed members, leader, moderators and online state * Refresh explicitly with one `/party list` request * Configure planned Dungeon classes and display confirmed live classes separately * Show missing and duplicate classes * Handle partial lists, joins/leaves, reconnects and class changes * Sort members by rank, class or join order * Use a compact/detailed, movable Party HUD * Copy names, whisper or perform explicit party actions * Require optional confirmation before kick or transfer actions Party, Carry and Dungeons share their observations. Unknown data stays unknown rather than becoming an assumed class or completion. Party Manager action buttons send their command when clicked. Open `/sl party`.
📣 Party Commands Support familiar shortcuts received in party chat. * Transfer, warp and allinvite requests * Floor and Master Mode join requests * Ping/TPS replies and local downtime reminders * Optional downtime reason text * Configurable permissions, trust, cooldowns and responses **Disabled by default.** Once enabled, an allowed request can trigger a configured server command or reply. SkyLume reacts to received client-visible messages; it does not perform combat or movement actions.
⚔️ Slayer Carry Tools Organize carry sessions, payments and progress in one place. * Manage orders, customers, queue position and active sessions * Choose Slayer type, tier, amount and price * Track payments with integer coin values * Record progress and keep local history * Pause, resume, cancel, refund and complete orders * Undo the latest completion * Use configurable reply templates and an optional Carry HUD * Review passive completion evidence and trade/payment suggestions * Reuse Party Manager's membership, presence and class observations Uncertain detections require confirmation. Returning customers remain paused until you resume them. Supported dungeon carry completion requires a confirmed result, matching floor and observed participants. SkyLume does not attack, start Slayer quests or accept trades for you. Detection depends on information visible to your client. Open `/sl carry` or `/sl replies`.
⚙️ Modern Settings Menu A compact settings menu with a familiar SkyBlock-focused layout. * Charcoal panels, Minecraft text and a centred version/creator header * Category arrows, indented groups and slim collapsible feature rows * Groups that start closed, with remembered explicit choices when menu memory is enabled * Compact dropdowns, switches, sliders, colour controls, text inputs and keybind controls * Wrapped setting explanations beside their controls * Global magnifier search or **Ctrl+F** across categories, groups, names and descriptions * Temporary expansion of search results without losing your saved open/closed choices * Clear a focused search with Escape, or right-click the search field/magnifier * Optional memory for searches, categories and supported list positions * Save, cancel, reset and undo, with navigation stored separately from pending edits * Ordinary switches, sliders and fixed choices stay in searchable main settings * Separate editors for routes, collections, layouts, interactive previews and history * JSON persistence, backups and recovery * A consistent frame for supported tool dialogs, with scrolling for dense forms * Optional Atkinson Hyperlegible text in supported HUD/inventory views Open `/skylume`, `/skylume config` or `/sl`. The config frontend is embedded; no separate config-library installation is required.
🧰 Additional Tools * Local calculator with `/sl calc` * Coordinate copying with clean integer coordinates * Separate item-stash and material-stash reminder filters * Configurable enchantment-level colours using a bundled catalog * Cursor-placement assistance for supported menu workflows * Storage palettes and search-highlight settings
## 📥 Installation 1. Use Minecraft Java Edition **26.2** with **Java 25 or newer**. 2. Install **Fabric Loader 0.19.5+** and **Fabric API 0.161.0+26.2 or a newer release compatible with 26.2**. 3. Place `skylume-2.6.0.jar` in the profile's `mods` folder, replacing the older SkyLume JAR. 4. Start Minecraft and open `/sl` or `/skylume`. ### Required dependency * **Fabric API** ### Optional integrations * **Mod Menu** — convenient Configure button * **Skyblocker** — supported QuickNav, profile lookups and Spirit-data integration * **REI** — supported Storage exclusion zones YACL, HM API and the networth calculator are bundled. No separate YACL or MoulConfig installation is required. Optional integration availability depends on the installed versions. ## 🔒 Data and Privacy Settings, remembered searches, observed Storage contents, item locks, routes, bindings and supported caches/history are saved locally. Storage uses previously observed data; account/profile-dependent histories stay scoped to their supported account or confirmed profile. Price features and explicit lookups can contact public market/item services; profile features use the supported provider. SkyLume does not require a player API key or upload item NBT to a valuation service. ## 🐞 Bug Reports and Feature Requests Found a problem or have an idea? [Report a bug or request a feature](https://github.com/Olihal1/Skylume/issues/new/choose). Include your SkyLume version, Minecraft version, installed mods and clear reproduction steps. Remove private information from logs before sharing them. The repository is provided for support, bug reports and feature requests. SkyLume is not affiliated with Mojang, Microsoft or Hypixel.
